# Reading in QC and Raw Data
``` {r import, clean, and check the QC}
# Function to read and clean one QC file
read_qc_file <- function(path) {
  read_csv(path, skip = 1, col_names = TRUE, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    rename(
      image_group = 1,
      file_name   = 2,
      dup_1       = 3,
      dup_2       = 4,
      orig_1      = 5,
      orig_2      = 6
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      across(dup_1:orig_2, as.numeric)
    )
}

# Function to compare original vs duplicate values within a row
check_match <- function(orig, dup) {
  orig_sorted <- sort(as.character(orig), na.last = TRUE)
  dup_sorted  <- sort(as.character(dup),  na.last = TRUE)
  identical(orig_sorted, dup_sorted)
}

# Function to score one QC dataset
score_qc_dataset <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      match = check_match(
        c(orig_1, orig_2),
        c(dup_1, dup_2)
      )
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
}

# File paths
qc_files <- list(
  bz555_1 = "/Volumes/LaCie/Neuron Analysis - 60x/Dendrite Results Folder/BZ555/bz555_day1_final_qc.csv",
  bz555_3 = "/Volumes/LaCie/Neuron Analysis - 60x/Dendrite Results Folder/BZ555/bz555_day3_final_qc.csv",
  bz555_5 = "/Volumes/LaCie/Neuron Analysis - 60x/Dendrite Results Folder/BZ555/bz555_day5_final_qc.csv",
  ua44_1  = "/Volumes/LaCie/Neuron Analysis - 60x/Dendrite Results Folder/UA44/ua44_day1_final_qc.csv",
  ua44_3  = "/Volumes/LaCie/Neuron Analysis - 60x/Dendrite Results Folder/UA44/ua44_day3_final_qc.csv",
  ua44_5  = "/Volumes/LaCie/Neuron Analysis - 60x/Dendrite Results Folder/UA44/ua44_day5_final_qc.csv"
)

# Read all QC files
qc_data <- map(qc_files, read_qc_file)

# Score all QC files
qc_results <- map(qc_data, score_qc_dataset)

# Summarize all QC files
qc_summary <- map_dfr(
  qc_results,
  ~ summarise(
    .x,
    n_matching = sum(match),
    total = n(),
    percent = mean(match) * 100
  ),
  .id = "dataset"
)

# View summary
qc_summary

#Averages to about 70.53 correct for the QC matching
```

``` {r importing the raw data and getting treatments}
data_bz555_1 <- read_csv("/Volumes/LaCie/Neuron Analysis - 60x/Dendrite Results Folder/BZ555/bz555_day1_final_raw.csv", skip = 1, col_names = TRUE) %>%
  rename(
    group_name = 1,
    den_1  = 2,
    den_2 = 3,
    file_name = 4
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(den_1:den_2, ~ as.numeric(.))
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    file_name_only = basename(str_replace_all(file_name, "\\\\", "/")),

    strain = word(file_name_only, 1, sep = fixed("_")),
    treatment = word(file_name_only, 2, sep = fixed("_")),

    date = paste(
      word(file_name_only, 3, sep = fixed("_")),
      word(file_name_only, 4, sep = fixed("_")),
      word(file_name_only, 5, sep = fixed("_")),
      sep = "_"
    ),

    id = word(file_name_only, -2, sep = fixed("_")),

    treatment = case_when(
      treatment == "solv"  ~ "Solv Ctrl",
      treatment == "ctrl"  ~ "Ctrl",
      treatment == "tca"   ~ "TCA",
      treatment == "tceoh" ~ "TCEOH",
      TRUE ~ treatment
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    expt = case_when(
      date == "1_26_2026" ~ "Expt 1",
      date == "2_2_26" ~ "Expt 2",
      date == "2_3_26" ~ "Expt 3",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(day = 1) %>%
  select(expt, id, strain, day, treatment, den_1, den_2)
```

# Chi Square Test
``` {r Chi Square test for treatment}
#Using Chi Square since this is the typical test used in the field for dendrite analysis. Running only the pairwise tests that make the most sense biologically.

#Helper function to run one pairwise chi-square test
run_one_chisq <- function(df, group1_label, group2_label, comparison_type,
                          strain_val = NA, treatment_val = NA, day_val = NA,
                          family_val = NA) {
  
  df <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(score)) %>%
    mutate(score = droplevels(factor(score)))
  
  tab <- table(df$group, df$score)
  
  if (nrow(tab) < 2 || ncol(tab) < 2) {
    return(tibble(
      family = family_val,
      comparison_type = comparison_type,
      strain = strain_val,
      treatment = treatment_val,
      day = day_val,
      group1 = group1_label,
      group2 = group2_label,
      chisq = NA_real_,
      df = NA_real_,
      p_value = NA_real_
    ))
  }
  
  test <- suppressWarnings(chisq.test(tab))
  
  tibble(
    family = family_val,
    comparison_type = comparison_type,
    strain = strain_val,
    treatment = treatment_val,
    day = day_val,
    group1 = group1_label,
    group2 = group2_label,
    chisq = unname(test$statistic),
    df = unname(test$parameter),
    p_value = test$p.value
  )
}

#Same treatment across days but within strain
run_day_pairwise_family <- function(data, treatment_levels, family_label) {
  day_pairs <- list(c("1", "3"), c("1", "5"), c("3", "5"))
  
  data %>%
    filter(treatment %in% treatment_levels) %>%
    filter(!is.na(score)) %>%
    mutate(
      strain = as.character(strain),
      treatment = as.character(treatment),
      day = as.character(day)
    ) %>%
    group_by(strain, treatment) %>%
    group_split() %>%
    map_dfr(function(df_sub) {
      strain_val <- unique(df_sub$strain)
      treatment_val <- unique(df_sub$treatment)
      
      map_dfr(day_pairs, function(pair) {
        subdf <- df_sub %>%
          filter(day %in% pair) %>%
          mutate(group = paste0("Day ", day))
        
        run_one_chisq(
          df = subdf,
          group1_label = paste0("Day ", pair[1]),
          group2_label = paste0("Day ", pair[2]),
          comparison_type = "Day within Strain x Treatment",
          strain_val = strain_val,
          treatment_val = treatment_val,
          day_val = NA,
          family_val = family_label
        )
      })
    })
}

#Control vs. treatment within day and strain
run_treatment_pairwise_family <- function(data, treatment_levels, family_label) {
  data %>%
    filter(treatment %in% treatment_levels) %>%
    filter(!is.na(score)) %>%
    mutate(
      strain = as.character(strain),
      day = as.character(day),
      treatment = as.character(treatment)
    ) %>%
    group_by(strain, day) %>%
    group_split() %>%
    map_dfr(function(df_sub) {
      strain_val <- unique(df_sub$strain)
      day_val <- unique(df_sub$day)
      
      subdf <- df_sub %>%
        mutate(group = treatment)
      
      run_one_chisq(
        df = subdf,
        group1_label = treatment_levels[1],
        group2_label = treatment_levels[2],
        comparison_type = "Treatment within Strain x Day",
        strain_val = strain_val,
        treatment_val = NA,
        day_val = day_val,
        family_val = family_label
      )
    })
}

#Across strains within the same day and treatment
run_strain_pairwise_family <- function(data, treatment_levels, family_label) {
  data %>%
    filter(treatment %in% treatment_levels) %>%
    filter(strain %in% c("bz555", "ua44")) %>%
    filter(!is.na(score)) %>%
    mutate(
      strain = as.character(strain),
      day = as.character(day),
      treatment = as.character(treatment)
    ) %>%
    group_by(day, treatment) %>%
    group_split() %>%
    map_dfr(function(df_sub) {
      day_val <- unique(df_sub$day)
      treatment_val <- unique(df_sub$treatment)
      
      subdf <- df_sub %>%
        mutate(group = strain)
      
      run_one_chisq(
        df = subdf,
        group1_label = "bz555",
        group2_label = "ua44",
        comparison_type = "Strain within Day x Treatment",
        strain_val = NA,
        treatment_val = treatment_val,
        day_val = day_val,
        family_val = family_label
      )
    })
}

# Helper function to get letters from the pairwise reuslts
make_letters_table <- function(results_df) {
  
  # Day letters: within each strain x treatment
  day_letters <- results_df %>%
    filter(comparison_type == "Day within Strain x Treatment") %>%
    group_by(strain, treatment) %>%
    group_split() %>%
    map_dfr(function(df_sub) {
      groups <- sort(unique(c(df_sub$group1, df_sub$group2)))
      pvec <- df_sub %>%
        filter(!is.na(p_adj_family)) %>%
        transmute(comp = paste(group1, group2, sep = "-"), p = p_adj_family) %>%
        deframe()
      
      letters <- multcompLetters(pvec, threshold = 0.05)$Letters
      
      tibble(
        comparison_type = "Day within Strain x Treatment",
        strain = unique(df_sub$strain),
        treatment = unique(df_sub$treatment),
        day = names(letters),
        label = unname(letters)
      ) %>%
        complete(day = groups, fill = list(label = ""))
    })
  
  # Treatment letters: within each strain x day
  treatment_letters <- results_df %>%
    filter(comparison_type == "Treatment within Strain x Day") %>%
    group_by(strain, day) %>%
    group_split() %>%
    map_dfr(function(df_sub) {
      groups <- sort(unique(c(df_sub$group1, df_sub$group2)))
      pvec <- df_sub %>%
        filter(!is.na(p_adj_family)) %>%
        transmute(comp = paste(group1, group2, sep = "-"), p = p_adj_family) %>%
        deframe()
      
      letters <- multcompLetters(pvec, threshold = 0.05)$Letters
      
      tibble(
        comparison_type = "Treatment within Strain x Day",
        strain = unique(df_sub$strain),
        day = unique(df_sub$day),
        treatment = names(letters),
        label = unname(letters)
      ) %>%
        complete(treatment = groups, fill = list(label = ""))
    })
  
  # Strain letters: within each day x treatment
  strain_letters <- results_df %>%
    filter(comparison_type == "Strain within Day x Treatment") %>%
    group_by(day, treatment) %>%
    group_split() %>%
    map_dfr(function(df_sub) {
      groups <- sort(unique(c(df_sub$group1, df_sub$group2)))
      pvec <- df_sub %>%
        filter(!is.na(p_adj_family)) %>%
        transmute(comp = paste(group1, group2, sep = "-"), p = p_adj_family) %>%
        deframe()
      
      letters <- multcompLetters(pvec, threshold = 0.05)$Letters
      
      tibble(
        comparison_type = "Strain within Day x Treatment",
        day = unique(df_sub$day),
        treatment = unique(df_sub$treatment),
        strain = names(letters),
        label = unname(letters)
      ) %>%
        complete(strain = groups, fill = list(label = ""))
    })
  
  bind_rows(day_letters, treatment_letters, strain_letters)
}

#Helper function for formatting results
format_pairwise_results <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      strain = recode(
        strain,
        "bz555" = "BZ555",
        "ua44" = "UA44",
        .default = strain
      ),
      treatment = recode(
        treatment,
        "Ctrl" = "Vehicle Control",
        "TCA" = "10 mM TCA",
        "Solv Ctrl" = "Solvent Control",
        "TCEOH" = "5 mM TCEOH",
        .default = treatment
      ),
      day = recode(
        day,
        "1" = "Day 1",
        "3" = "Day 3",
        "5" = "Day 5",
        .default = day
      ),
      group1 = recode(
        group1,
        "Ctrl" = "Vehicle Control",
        "TCA" = "10 mM TCA",
        "Solv Ctrl" = "Solvent Control",
        "TCEOH" = "5 mM TCEOH",
        "bz555" = "BZ555",
        "ua44" = "UA44",
        .default = group1
      ),
      group2 = recode(
        group2,
        "Ctrl" = "Vehicle Control",
        "TCA" = "10 mM TCA",
        "Solv Ctrl" = "Solvent Control",
        "TCEOH" = "5 mM TCEOH",
        "bz555" = "BZ555",
        "ua44" = "UA44",
        .default = group2
      ),
      chisq = ifelse(is.na(chisq), NA, round(chisq, 4)),
      p_value = ifelse(is.na(p_value), NA, round(p_value, 6)),
      p_adj_family = ifelse(is.na(p_adj_family), NA, round(p_adj_family, 6))
    ) %>%
    rename(
      Family = family,
      Comparison_Type = comparison_type,
      Strain = strain,
      Treatment = treatment,
      Day = day,
      Group_1 = group1,
      Group_2 = group2,
      Chi_square = chisq,
      Degrees_of_Freedom = df,
      Raw_p_value = p_value,
      Adjusted_p_value_family = p_adj_family
    )
}

        .default = treatment
      ),
      day = recode(
        day,
        "1" = "Day 1",
        "3" = "Day 3",
        "5" = "Day 5",
        "Day 1" = "Day 1",
        "Day 3" = "Day 3",
        "Day 5" = "Day 5",
        .default = day
      ),
      strain = recode(
        strain,
        "Day 1" = "Day 1",
        "Day 3" = "Day 3",
        "Day 5" = "Day 5",
        .default = strain
      ),
      treatment = recode(
        treatment,
        "Day 1" = "Day 1",
        "Day 3" = "Day 3",
        "Day 5" = "Day 5",
        .default = treatment
      )
    ) %>%
    rename(
      Comparison_Type = comparison_type,
      Strain = strain,
      Treatment = treatment,
      Day = day,
      Letters = label
    )
}

#TCA pairwise
day_pairwise_tca <- run_day_pairwise_family(
  data = all_data_long,
  treatment_levels = c("Ctrl", "TCA"),
  family_label = "TCA Family"
)

treatment_pairwise_tca <- run_treatment_pairwise_family(
  data = all_data_long,
  treatment_levels = c("Ctrl", "TCA"),
  family_label = "TCA Family"
```

# Cumulative Link Mixed Models
``` {r stats - CLMM}
#Answers a different question, though CLMM analysis isn't common in the field for C. elegans dendrite analysis. Models how the odds of being at a higher score will change with strain/treatment/day
options(scipen = 999)

#TCA
model_tca <- clmm(
  score ~ strain * day * treatment + (1 | id),
  data = tca_data
)

summary(model_tca)

model_coef_table_tca <- as.data.frame(summary(model_tca)$coefficients) %>%
  rownames_to_column("term")

treatment_emm_tca <- emmeans(
  model_tca,
  pairwise ~ treatment | strain * day,
  mode = "latent",
  adjust = "tukey"
)

treatment_emmeans_tca <- as.data.frame(treatment_emm_tca$emmeans)
treatment_contrasts_tca <- as.data.frame(treatment_emm_tca$contrasts)

day_emm_tca <- emmeans(
  model_tca,
  pairwise ~ day | strain * treatment,
  mode = "latent",
  adjust = "tukey"
)

day_emmeans_tca <- as.data.frame(day_emm_tca$emmeans)
day_contrasts_tca <- as.data.frame(day_emm_tca$contrasts)

strain_emm_tca <- emmeans(
  model_tca,
  pairwise ~ strain | day * treatment,
  mode = "latent",
  adjust = "tukey"
)

strain_emmeans_tca <- as.data.frame(strain_emm_tca$emmeans)
strain_contrasts_tca <- as.data.frame(strain_emm_tca$contrasts)

#TCEOH
```

``` {r cleaning up treatment emm tables}
#Helper function
make_treatment_table <- function(emm_df, contrast_df, treatment_order = NULL) {
  
  emm_df <- emm_df %>%
    mutate(
      treatment = as.character(treatment),
      strain = as.character(strain),
      day = as.character(day),
      emmean = round(emmean, 4),
      SE = round(SE, 4),
      emm_se = paste0(sprintf("%.4f", emmean), " ± ", sprintf("%.4f", SE))
    )
  
  if (!is.null(treatment_order)) {
    emm_df <- emm_df %>%
      mutate(treatment = factor(treatment, levels = treatment_order))
  }
  
  emm_wide <- emm_df %>%
    select(strain, day, treatment, emm_se) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = treatment,
      values_from = emm_se
    )
  
  contrast_clean <- contrast_df %>%
    mutate(
      strain = as.character(strain),
      day = as.character(day),
      estimate = round(estimate, 4),
      z.ratio = round(z.ratio, 4),
      p.value = ifelse(p.value < 0.0001, "<0.0001", sprintf("%.4f", round(p.value, 4)))
    ) %>%
    rename(
      Difference = estimate,
      `z-ratio` = z.ratio,
      `p-value` = p.value
    ) %>%
    select(strain, day, Difference, `z-ratio`, `p-value`)
  
  final_table <- emm_wide %>%
    left_join(contrast_clean, by = c("strain", "day")) %>%
    mutate(
      strain = recode(
        strain,
        "bz555" = "BZ555",
        "ua44" = "UA44"
      ),
      day = recode(
        day,
        "1" = "Day 1",
        "3" = "Day 3",
        "5" = "Day 5"
      )
    ) %>%
    arrange(strain, day)
  
  final_table
}

#TCA table
tca_treatment_table <- make_treatment_table(
  emm_df = treatment_emmeans_tca,
  contrast_df = treatment_contrasts_tca,
  treatment_order = c("Ctrl", "TCA")
) %>%
  rename(
    Strain = strain,
    Day = day,
    `Vehicle Control EMM ± SE` = Ctrl,
    `10 mM TCA EMM ± SE` = TCA
  )

#TCEOH Table
tceoh_treatment_table <- make_treatment_table(
  emm_df = treatment_emmeans_tceoh,
  contrast_df = treatment_contrasts_tceoh,
  treatment_order = c("Solv Ctrl", "TCEOH")
) %>%
  rename(
    Strain = strain,
    Day = day,
    `Solvent Control EMM ± SE` = `Solv Ctrl`,
    `5 mM TCEOH EMM ± SE` = TCEOH
  )
```

``` {r cleaning up strain latent emm tables}
make_strain_table <- function(contrast_df) {
  contrast_df %>%
    mutate(
      day = as.character(day),
      treatment = as.character(treatment),
      contrast = as.character(contrast),
      estimate = as.numeric(estimate),
      SE = as.numeric(SE),
      z.ratio = as.numeric(z.ratio),
      p.value = as.numeric(p.value)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Day = recode(
        day,
        "1" = "Day 1",
        "3" = "Day 3",
        "5" = "Day 5"
      ),
      Dose = recode(
        treatment,
        "Ctrl" = "Vehicle Control",
        "TCA" = "10 mM TCA",
        "Solv Ctrl" = "Solvent Control",
        "TCEOH" = "5 mM TCEOH"
      ),
      Comparison = recode(
        contrast,
        "bz555 - ua44" = "BZ555 - UA44",
        "ua44 - bz555" = "UA44 - BZ555"
      ),
      Estimate = sprintf("%.4f", round(estimate, 4)),
      SE = sprintf("%.4f", round(SE, 4)),
      `z-ratio` = sprintf("%.4f", round(z.ratio, 4)),
      `Adjusted p-value` = ifelse(
        p.value < 0.0001,
        "<0.0001",
        sprintf("%.4f", round(p.value, 4))
      )
    ) %>%
    select(
      Day,
      Dose,
      Comparison,
      Estimate,
      SE,
      `z-ratio`,
      `Adjusted p-value`
    ) %>%
    arrange(Dose, Day)
}

# TCA strain table
tca_strain_table <- make_strain_table(strain_contrasts_tca)

# TCEOH strain table
tceoh_strain_table <- make_strain_table(strain_contrasts_tceoh)

# View them
tca_strain_table
tceoh_strain_table
```

``` {r cleaning up day latent emm tables}
make_day_table <- function(emm_df, contrast_df) {
  
  emm_df_clean <- emm_df %>%
    mutate(
      strain = as.character(strain),
      day = as.character(day),
      treatment = as.character(treatment),
      emmean = as.numeric(emmean),
      SE = as.numeric(SE),
      emmean = round(emmean, 4),
      SE = round(SE, 4),
      emm_se = paste0(sprintf("%.4f", emmean), " ± ", sprintf("%.4f", SE))
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      day_label = recode(
        day,
        "1" = "Day 1 EMM ± SE",
        "3" = "Day 3 EMM ± SE",
        "5" = "Day 5 EMM ± SE"
      )
    )
  
  emm_wide <- emm_df_clean %>%
    select(strain, treatment, day_label, emm_se) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = day_label,
      values_from = emm_se
    )
  
  contrast_clean <- contrast_df %>%
    mutate(
      strain = as.character(strain),
      treatment = as.character(treatment),
      contrast = as.character(contrast),
      estimate = as.numeric(estimate),
      z.ratio = as.numeric(z.ratio),
      p.value = as.numeric(p.value)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Strain = recode(
        strain,
        "bz555" = "BZ555",
        "ua44" = "UA44"
      ),
      Dose = recode(
        treatment,
        "Ctrl" = "Vehicle Control",
        "TCA" = "10 mM TCA",
        "Solv Ctrl" = "Solvent Control",
        "TCEOH" = "5 mM TCEOH"
      ),
      Comparison = recode(
        contrast,
        "1 - 3" = "Day 1 - Day 3",
        "1 - 5" = "Day 1 - Day 5",
        "3 - 5" = "Day 3 - Day 5"
      ),
      Difference = sprintf("%.4f", round(estimate, 4)),
      `z-ratio` = sprintf("%.4f", round(z.ratio, 4)),
      `Adjusted p-value` = ifelse(
        p.value < 0.0001,
        "<0.0001",
        sprintf("%.4f", round(p.value, 4))
      )
    ) %>%
    select(
      strain,
      treatment,
      Strain,
      Dose,
      Comparison,
      Difference,
      `z-ratio`,
      `Adjusted p-value`
    )
  
  final_table <- contrast_clean %>%
    left_join(emm_wide, by = c("strain", "treatment")) %>%
    select(
      Strain,
      Dose,
      `Day 1 EMM ± SE`,
      `Day 3 EMM ± SE`,
      `Day 5 EMM ± SE`,
      Comparison,
      Difference,
      `z-ratio`,
      `Adjusted p-value`
    ) %>%
    arrange(Dose, Strain, Comparison)
  
  final_table
}

# TCA day table

  emm_df = day_emmeans_tca,
  contrast_df = day_contrasts_tca
)

# TCEOH day table

  emm_df = day_emmeans_tceoh,
  contrast_df = day_contrasts_tceoh
)
```

``` {r plotting}
plot_data_tca <- all_data_long %>%
  filter(treatment %in% c("Ctrl", "TCA")) %>%
  filter(score %in% c(0, 1, 2, 3, 4)) %>%
  mutate(
    score = factor(score, levels = 0:4),
    day = factor(day, levels = c(1, 3, 5)),
    treatment = factor(treatment, levels = c("Ctrl", "TCA")),
    strain = factor(strain, levels = c("bz555", "ua44"))
  ) %>%
  group_by(strain, day, treatment, score) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  tidyr::complete(
    strain,
    day,
    treatment,
    score,
    fill = list(n = 0)
  ) %>%
  group_by(strain, day, treatment) %>%
  mutate(
    proportion = n / sum(n)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

``` {r rounding the stat tables - CLMM}
round_numeric <- function(df, digits = 4) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      across(
        where(is.numeric),
        ~ format(round(.x, digits), nsmall = digits, scientific = FALSE)
      )
    )
}

format_pvals <- function(df) {
  p_cols <- names(df)[grepl("p.value|p_value", names(df), ignore.case = TRUE)]
  
  df %>%
    mutate(
      across(
        all_of(p_cols),
        ~ ifelse(as.numeric(.) < 0.0001, "<0.0001", sprintf("%.4f", as.numeric(.)))
      )
    )
}
```
